elements.name: Aberrant Mind (UA)
elements.desc:
An alien influence has wrapped its tendrils around you, warping you in both body and mind. Perhaps a psychic splinter lodged in your psyche after you suffered domination by an aboleth. Maybe you were born somewhere tainted by the Far Realm, a planar blot that changed you forever. Or perhaps mind flayers kidnapped you, subjecting you to the nightmarish process of ceremorphosis—but the transformation failed and left you altered.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 61 — Aberrant Mind

elements.name: Clockwork Soul (UA)
elements.desc:
A plane of utmost order, Mechanus is a realm overseen by a godlike entity called Primus, whose actions are inscrutable and calculations, vast. You, or someone from your lineage, might have become entangled in one of the machinations of the leader of the modrons. Perhaps you were exposed to an artifact created by Primus, or your ancestor took part in the Great Modron March in some way.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 68 — Subclasses, Part 2

elements.name: Favored Soul (UA)
elements.desc:
Sometimes the spark of magic that fuels a sorcerer comes from a divine source that glimmers within the soul. This is the original 2019-era Favored Soul. For the later revision, see `Favored Soul Revisited (UA)`.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 3 — Modifying Classes

elements.name: Favored Soul Revisited (UA)
elements.desc:
Sometimes the spark of magic that fuels a sorcerer comes from a divine source that glimmers within the soul. Having such a favored soul, your innate magic might come from a distant but powerful familial connection to a divine being. Perhaps your ancestor was an angel, transformed into a mortal and sent to fight in a god's name. Or your birth might align with an ancient prophecy, marking you as a servant of the gods or a chosen vessel of divine magic.

Favored souls, with their natural magnetism and strong personalities, are often seen as threats by traditional religious hierarchies. As outsiders who command the power of the gods, these sorcerers can undermine the existing order and claim a direct tie to the divine.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 28 — Sorcerer

Note: This is the 2020 revision. For the original, see `Favored Soul (UA)`.

rules.grant: Class Feature:Divine Magic (Favored Soul Revisited UA)

elements.name: Giant Soul (UA)
elements.desc:
The giants once dwelled in a fabled realm known as Ostoria, a paradise for their folk that reflected their mastery of the mortal realm. In time, Ostoria fell, and the giants were scattered and broken. During that mythic era, the giants granted a few chosen individuals among the small folk a shard of their great power. These favored people were caught in the same tragedy that sundered Ostoria. Since that time, they have spread across the many worlds of the multiverse. Now and again, one of their descendants manifests the gifts imparted by the giants, granting them sorcerous magic that allows them to command the elements and gain the might of a giant.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 51 — Giant Soul

rules.grant: Class Feature:Blessing of the All Father (Giant Soul UA)

elements.name: Lunar Magic (UA)
elements.desc:
On many worlds, the moon is a revered celestial body with magical properties. On Krynn, the gods of magic are associated with the world's three moons. On the world of Toril, the god Selûne uses the light of the moon to battle darkness. On Eberron, scholars of the Draconic Prophecy decipher ancient secrets from the waxing and waning of that world's twelve moons.

You, or someone from your lineage, has been exposed to the concentrated magic of the moon (or moons) of your world, imbuing you with lunar magic. Perhaps your ancestor was involved in a druidic ritual involving an eclipse, or maybe a mystical fragment of a moon crashed near you. However you came to have your magic, your connection to the moon is obvious when you cast sorcerer spells.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 81 — Heroes of Krynn

Manifestations of Lunar Magic
1: You glow with faint light that matches the color of a moon from your world.
2: Your pupils shift in shape, matching the current phase of a moon from your world.
3: Spectral manifestations of the moon (or moons) of your world orbit you.
4: Your shadow is limned in faint light, as if it were a lunar body during a solar eclipse.

elements.name: Mage of Quandrix (UA)
elements.desc:
For those who become Mages of Quandrix, math and magic go hand-in-hand. Such individuals learn to break down natural phenomena into their core numerical components and, through manipulating those, alter reality on a whim. Their talents range from tangible physics, like multiplying plant growth and redistributing elements of probability and acceleration, to bizarrely theoretical exercises that warp the fundamentals of space and self.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 79 — Mages of Strixhaven

Note: The source lists Sorcerer and Wizard as eligible classes. This entry supports `Class:Sorcerer`. If you build `Wizard.json`, add a separate `Subclass:Mage of Quandrix (Wizard UA)` variant — do not duplicate this ID.

elements.name: Phoenix Sorcery (UA)
elements.desc:
Your power draws from the immortal flame that fuels the legendary phoenix. You or your ancestors perhaps rendered a phoenix a great service, or you were born in its presence. Whatever the cause, a shard of the phoenix's power dwells within you.

That power is a mixed blessing. Like the mythical creature, you can invoke fiery energy and gain the ability to cheat death itself. This power comes at a cost. The fire within you seethes, demanding to be unleashed. You sometimes find yourself absentmindedly feeding fires. You can't bear to allow a fire to sputter out. You feel most comfortable while holding a lit torch or sitting in front of a campfire.

More importantly, this gift comes with no special protection from fire. You are as vulnerable as any other creature to fiery magic, including your own.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 28 — Sorcerer

elements.name: Psionic Soul (UA)
elements.desc:
One day a light blazed forth within you—the illumination of psionic power. Your mind now simmers with this power, the full extent of which you won't fully grasp for years to come. You can touch other minds with it and alter the world around you by using it to control the magical energy of the multiverse. Will this power shine from you as a hopeful beacon to others? Or will you be a source of terror to those who feel the stab of your mind and witness the strange manifestations of your might?

Source: Unearthed Arcana 71 — Psionic Options Revisited

elements.name: Sea Sorcery (UA)
elements.desc:
The power of water is the strength of flexibility, resilience, and a relentless nature. Water parts to allow a ship to sail over it or a diver to plunge into it, but their passing leaves no mark. Water flowing down a mountain reaches the sea. It might bend and turn across valleys and down hillsides, but it slowly and steadily returns to the waves. Those whose souls are touched by the power of elemental water command a similar power.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 28 — Sorcerer

elements.name: Shadow (UA)
elements.desc:
Your innate magic comes from the Shadowfell. You might trace your lineage to an entity from that place, or perhaps you were exposed to its fell energy and transformed in some fundamental manner.

The power of shadow magic casts a strange pall over your physical presence. The spark of life that sustains you is muffled, as if it struggles to remain viable against the dark energy that imbues your soul. At your option, you can pick from or roll on the following table to create a unique quirk for your character.

Shadow Sorcerer Quirks
1: You are always icy cold to the touch.
2: When you are asleep, you don't appear to breathe (though you must still breathe to survive).
3: You don't seem to bleed, even when badly injured.
4: Your heart beats once per minute. This event sometimes surprises you.
5: You have trouble remembering that living creatures and corpses should be treated differently.
6: You blinked. Once. Last week.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 10 — Light, Dark, Underdark!

elements.name: Stone Sorcery (UA)
elements.desc:
Your magic springs from a mystical link between your soul and the magic of elemental earth. You might trace a distant ancestor to the Plane of Earth, or your family might have earned a mighty boon in return for a service to the dao lords. Whatever your past, the magic of elemental earth is yours to command.

Your link to earth magic grants you extraordinary resilience, and stone sorcerers have a natural affinity for combat. A steel blade feels like a natural extension of your body, and sorcerers with this origin have a knack for wielding both shields and weapons. In combat your place is amid the fray. You rely on your elemental nature to shield you from harm and your magic and metal weapons to overwhelm your foes.

Source: Unearthed Arcana 28 — Sorcerer

elements.name: Psionic Spells (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Aberrant Mind feature.

Starting at 1st level, your aberrant nature changes your mind in subtle but profound ways. You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Psionic Spells table. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Warped Being (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Aberrant Mind feature.

Starting at 1st level, your aberrant origin protects you from harm. Your body might have a coating of viscous slime, tough hide, scales, or an invisible psionic barrier (choose the form of protection when you gain this feature). See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Psionic Sorcery (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Aberrant Mind feature.

Beginning at 6th level, when you cast any of the spells gained from your Psionic Spells feature, you can cast it by expending a spell slot as normal or by spending a number of sorcery points equal to the spell's level. If you cast the spell using sorcery points, it requires no components.

elements.name: Psychic Defenses (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Aberrant Mind feature.

At 6th level, you gain resistance to psychic damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

elements.name: Revelation in Flesh (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Aberrant Mind feature.

Beginning at 14th level, you can unleash the aberrant truth hidden within your flesh. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 or more sorcery points to magically transform your body for 1 minute. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Warp Reality (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Aberrant Mind feature.

At 18th level, you become the focal point of a reality-warping anomaly. As an action, you can magically radiate a transparent, 20-foot-radius aura for 1 minute. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Clockwork Magic (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Clockwork Soul feature.

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Clockwork Spells table. Each spell counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Restore Balance (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Clockwork Soul feature.

Starting at 1st level, your connection to the plane of absolute order allows you to equalize chaotic moments. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Bulwark of Law (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Clockwork Soul feature.

Starting at 6th level, you can imbue a creature with a shimmering shield of order. As an action, you can expend 1 to 5 sorcery points to create a magical ward around yourself or another creature you can see within 30 feet of you. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Trance of Order (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Clockwork Soul feature.

Starting at 14th level, you gain the ability to enter a state of clockwork consciousness as a bonus action. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Clockwork Cavalcade (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Clockwork Soul feature.

At 18th level, you summon spirits of order to restore balance around you. As an action, you summon the spirits in a 30-foot cube originating from you. The spirits look like modrons or other constructs of your choice. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Chosen of the Gods (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Favored Soul feature.

At 1st level, you choose one of the cleric class's divine domains. You add that domain's spells for 1st-level clerics to your known spells. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Favored Soul UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Favored Soul feature.

At 1st level, you gain proficiency in light armor, medium armor, shields, and simple weapons.

elements.name: Divine Wings (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Favored Soul feature.

At 14th level, you gain the ability to sprout a pair of wings from your back (feathered or bat-like, your choice), gaining a flying speed equal to your current walking speed. You can create these wings as a bonus action on your turn. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Power of the Chosen (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Favored Soul feature.

Starting at 18th level, when you cast one of the spells you learned from your Chosen of the Gods class feature, you regain hit points equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum +1) + the spell's level.

elements.id: Class Feature:Divine Magic (Favored Soul Revisited UA)
elements.name: Divine Magic (Favored Soul Revisited UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Favored Soul Revisited feature.

Your link to the divine allows you to learn spells normally associated with the cleric class. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Supernatural Resilience (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Favored Soul Revisited feature.

At 1st level, the blessing of the gods grants you enhanced durability. Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class.

elements.name: Favored by the Gods (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Favored Soul Revisited feature.

Starting at 1st level, divine power guards your destiny. If you fail a saving throw or miss with an attack roll, you can roll 2d4 and add it to the total, possibly changing the outcome.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

elements.name: Blessed Countenance (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Favored Soul Revisited feature.

At 6th level, your divine essence causes you to undergo a minor physical transformation. Your appearance takes on an otherworldly version of one of the following qualities (your choice): beautiful, youthful, kind, or imposing. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Divine Purity (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Favored Soul Revisited feature.

At 14th level, you become immune to disease, poison damage, and the poisoned condition.

elements.name: Unearthly Recovery (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Favored Soul Revisited feature.

At 18th level, you gain the ability to overcome grievous injuries. As a bonus action when you have less than half of your hit points remaining, you can regain a number of hit points equal to half your hit point maximum. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Jotun Resilience (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Giant Soul feature.

The resilience of giants flows through your body. At 1st level, your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class.

elements.name: Mark of the Ordning (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Giant Soul feature.

At 1st level, you discover innate magical abilities within yourself that are based on your giant heritage. Select one of the giant types from the Mark of the Ordning table. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Soul of Lost Ostoria (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Giant Soul feature.

Starting at 6th level, you gain a benefit whenever you cast one of the spells granted by your Mark of the Ordning Feature. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Rage of Fallen Ostoria (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Giant Soul feature.

Starting at 14th level, you gain the ability to channel the souls of your ancestors into your physical form. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.id: Class Feature:Blessing of the All Father (Giant Soul UA)
elements.name: Blessing of the All Father (Giant Soul UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Giant Soul feature.

At 18th level, your Constitution score increases by 2, up to a maximum of 22. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Moon Fire (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Lunar Magic feature.

Starting at 1st level, you can call down the radiant light of the moon on command. You learn the Sacred Flame spell, which doesn't count against the number of sorcerer cantrips you know. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Lunar Embodiment (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Lunar Magic feature.

You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Lunar Spells table. Each spell counts as a sorcerer spell for you, but it doesn't count against the number of sorcerer spells you know. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Lunar Boons (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Lunar Magic feature.

Starting at 6th level, lunar phases influence your metamagic. Each lunar phase is associated with spells of the following schools of magic: See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Waxing and Waning (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Lunar Magic feature.

Starting at 6th level, you gain greater control over the phases of your lunar magic. As a bonus action, you can spend 1 sorcery point to change your lunar phase for a different one.

elements.name: Lunar Empowerment (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Lunar Magic feature.

Starting at 14th level, the power of a lunar phase saturates your being. Whenever you choose a lunar phase to affect your magic, you also gain the following benefit associated with that phase: See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Lunar Phenomenon (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Lunar Magic feature.

At 18th level, your lunar phase magic bursts. As a bonus action, you can tap into a special power of the lunar phase you are currently in. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Quandrix Spells (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Mage of Quandrix feature.

You learn the cantrip Guidance and the 1st-level spell Guiding Bolt. You learn additional spells when you reach certain levels in this class, as shown on the Quandrix Spells table. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Functions of Probability (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Mage of Quandrix feature.

By iterating on the mathematical patterns of reality, you can nudge chance to tilt around a creature. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Velocity Shift (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Mage of Quandrix feature.

You learn to manipulate kinetic formulas and alter the velocity of another creature. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Null Equation (UA)
elements.desc:
10th-level Mage of Quandrix feature.

Through careful calculations, you beset your enemies with abstract equations that reduce their might. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Quantum Tunneling (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Mage of Quandrix feature.

Your mathematical expertise extends to altering the foundational equations of your very being. You gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Ignite (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Phoenix Sorcery feature.

At 1st level, you gain the ability to start fires with a touch. As an action, you can magically ignite a flammable object you touch with your hand—an object such as a torch, a piece of tinder, or the hem of drapes.

elements.name: Mantle of Flame (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Phoenix Sorcery feature.

Starting at 1st level, you can unleash the phoenix fire that blazes within you. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Phoenix Spark (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Phoenix Sorcery feature.

Starting at 6th level, the fiery energy within you grows restless and vengeful. In the face of defeat, it surges outward to preserve you in a fiery roar. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Nourishing Fire (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Phoenix Sorcery feature.

Starting at 14th level, your fire spells soothe and restore you. When you expend a spell slot to cast a spell that includes a fire damage roll, you regain hit points equal to the slot's level + your Charisma modifier.

elements.name: Form of the Phoenix (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Phoenix Sorcery feature.

At 18th level, you finally master the spark of fire that dances within you. While under the effect of your Mantle of Flame feature, you gain additional benefits: See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Psionic Origin (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Psionic Soul feature.

As a Psionic Soul sorcerer, you decide how you acquired your powers. Were you born with them, and did they manifest throughout childhood? Or did an extraordinary event later in life leave you shining with psionic awareness? See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Psionic Talent (Psionic Soul UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Psionic Soul feature.

Starting at 1st level you harbor a wellspring of psionic power within yourself, an energy that ebbs and flows as you channel it in various ways. This power is represented by your Psionic Talent die, the starting size of which is a d6. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Psi Replenishment (Psionic Soul UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Psionic Soul feature.

At 1st level, as a bonus action, you can calm your mind for a moment and restore your Psionic Talent die to its starting size. You then can't use Psi Replenishment again until you finish a long rest.

elements.name: Psychic Strike (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Psionic Soul feature.

At 6th level, you have learned to channel additional psychic energy into your spells. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Mind Over Body (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Psionic Soul feature.

When you reach 14th level, you can now use the psi that flows through you to give your body extraordinary abilities. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Psychic Aura (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Psionic Soul feature.

At 18th level, if your Psionic Talent die is available, you can unleash your psionic power in a crackling aura of psychic energy; as a bonus action, you can magically radiate this transparent, 30-foot-radius aura for 1 minute or until you're incapacitated or lose the use of your Psionic Talent die. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Soul of the Sea (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Sea Sorcery feature.

At 1st level, your tie to the sea grants you the ability to breathe underwater, and you have a swim speed equal to your walking speed.

elements.name: Curse of the Sea (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Sea Sorcery feature.

When you choose this origin at 1st level, you learn the secret of infusing your spells with a watery curse. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Watery Defense (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Sea Sorcery feature.

At 6th level, you gain resistance to fire damage. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Shifting Form (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Sea Sorcery feature.

Starting at 14th level, you gain the ability to enter a liquid state while moving. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Water Soul (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Sea Sorcery feature.

Starting at 18th level, your being is altered by the power of the sea. You gain the following benefits:

You no longer need to eat, drink, or sleep.
A critical hit against you becomes a normal hit.
You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

elements.name: Eyes of the Dark (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Shadow feature.

From 1st level, you have darkvision with a range of 60 feet. You can cast Darkness by spending 1 sorcery point. You can see through any Darkness spell you cast using this ability.

elements.name: Strength of the Grave (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Shadow feature.

Starting at 1st level, your existence in a twilight state between life and death makes you difficult to defeat. Whenever damage reduces you to 0 hit points, you can make a Constitution saving throw (DC 5 + the damage taken). See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Hound of Ill Omen (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Shadow feature.

At 6th level, you gain the ability to call forth a howling creature of darkness to harass your foes. As a bonus action, you can spend 3 sorcery points to summon a hound of ill omen to target one creature you can see. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Shadow Walk (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Shadow feature.

At 14th level, you gain the ability to step from one shadow into another. When you are in dim light or darkness, as a bonus action, you can teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.

elements.name: Shadow Form (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Shadow feature.

At 18th level, you can spend 3 sorcery points to transform yourself into a shadow form as a bonus action. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Bonus Proficiencies (Stone UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Stone Sorcery feature.

At 1st level, you gain proficiency with shields, simple weapons, and martial weapons.

elements.name: Metal Magic (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Stone Sorcery feature.

Your affinity for metal gives you the option to learn some non-sorcerer spells that focus on weapon attacks. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Stone's Durability (UA)
elements.desc:
1st-level Stone Sorcery feature.

At 1st level, your connection to stone gives you extra fortitude. Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Stone Aegis (UA)
elements.desc:
6th-level Stone Sorcery feature.

Starting at 6th level, your command of earth magic grows stronger, allowing you to harness it for your allies' protection. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Stone's Edge (UA)
elements.desc:
14th-level Stone Sorcery feature.

Starting at 14th level, your mastery of earth magic allows you to add the force of elemental earth to your spells. When you cast a spell that deals damage, choose one creature damaged by that spell on the round you cast it. See the side panel for the full text.

elements.name: Earth Master's Aegis (UA)
elements.desc:
18th-level Stone Sorcery feature.

Beginning at 18th level, when you use your Stone's Aegis to protect an ally, you can choose up to three creatures to gain its benefits.
